text: The corrected real diagnostic then failed closed because a 120 ms Grakern operation with the frozen 10 forks x 10 samples schedule accumulated only about 12 seconds, contradicting the 30-second evidence floor while batching at or above 100 ms was forbidden. Repaired the constructive contract: standard warm rows now use 10 forks x 30 samples; sub-100-ms operations batch to a 100-ms target; operations at or above 100 ms remain unbatched. This targets at least 30 seconds for every standard row without inflating fast-row court time. Updated ADR and worker docs; court suite 14/14, JVM worker 15/15, GraKeL 4/4, GraphKernels.jl 8 row-boundaries, Ruff and scalafmt gates pass.
